RegistrationInfo.Description: Ensures the Halcyon Feeding Table pulse runs continuously in the background, anchoring the lattice.

Exec.Arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Start-Job -Name FeedingTable -ScriptBlock { while ($true) { & \"D:\Halcyon_Lives\scripts\feeding_table.ps1\"; Start-Sleep -Seconds (Get-Random -Minimum 60 -Maximum 300) } } | Out-Null; Get-Job -Name FeedingTable | Where-Object { $_.State -ne 'Running' } | ForEach-Object { Receive-Job $_.Id -Keep; Start-Job -Name FeedingTable -ScriptBlock { while ($true) { & \"D:\Halcyon_Lives\scripts\feeding_table.ps1\"; Start-Sleep -Seconds (Get-Random -Minimum 60 -Maximum 300) } } | Out-Null }"
